objects.name: Analytic 2284
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a Windows process sending Industrial Control System (ICS) broadcast discovery frames from a process not associated with a recognized ICS asset management or commissioning tool. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: EventCode=3 outbound User Datagram Protocol (UDP) broadcast traffic from process not in recognized Industrial Control Systems (ICS) asset management tools
